content.College of Cardiology/American Heart Ass: This document reviews various studies and clinical trials related to systemic right ventricles, Fontan procedure, and associated congenital heart disease surgeries. It includes data on heart transplant outcomes, effectiveness of certain medications and procedures, and implications of different treatment strategies on long-term patient health. It also discusses rehabilitation and management strategies for patients with complex congenital heart defects post-surgery. The guideline underscores the importance of personalized treatment plans based on individual patient conditions and provides a comprehensive overview of past studies and their outcomes.
